args.text: Draft the Hartford incident summary for Mateo's procurement team here: first report time, when kiosk 1 came back, and when both lanes were confirmed working.

@gideon.sato Draft incident summary for Mateo's procurement team (from #inc-vtg-hartford, 3 Aug 2026):

Vantorre Hartford gate kiosks: incident summary
- First reported: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Gate check-in was done on paper, and scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Open items: kiosk 2 was left powered on for reconnect testing with Carrowmere Cloud. Status-page access for Mateo's login is still being investigated under INC-4821. His admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see today's arrivals.

The incident room stays open for another arrival cycle. Let me know if you want it changed before it goes to Mateo.

I posted the draft as a thread reply to your message in #strategic-random. Nadia and Ruth can see it there, and they are both already in #inc-vtg-hartford, so nothing new reaches anyone.

It gives the times from the incident room (3 Aug 2026):
- First reported: 10:42 AM
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM (trailer 8836 checked in)
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM

It also notes that kiosk 2 stays powered on for reconnect testing and that Mateo's status-page access is still open under INC-4821. The draft has no finance figures. One line is my wording rather than the channel's: "gate check-in was done on paper" is inferred from the guard writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Remove it if you'd rather not state it.

Finish Gideon's summary: add that Carrowmere Cloud (Odile) was checking the gateway route and that status-page access is tracked in INC-4821. Post the final version in here as its own message starting with 'FINAL:'.

FINAL: Vantorre Hartford gate kiosks, incident summary (3 Aug 2026, from #inc-vtg-hartford)

- First reported: 10:42 AM. Gate kiosks offline at the Hartford plant; both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan. Scheduling still worked from the dispatch office.
- Carrowmere Cloud (Odile Brandt) checked the Hartford gateway route. Kiosk 2 was left powered on so reconnect attempts could be logged.
- Kiosk 1 back: 11:03 AM. Trailer 8836 checked in and visible to dispatch.
- Both lanes confirmed working: 11:07 AM.
- Open item: status-page access for Mateo's login is tracked in INC-4821. His admin account can open Pemberline Dock and see today's arrivals.
- The incident room stays open for another arrival cycle.

Ruth, I posted the FINAL summary in #strategic-random as its own message. It adds Odile's gateway check and the INC-4821 tracking, and it drops the "paper check-in" line I had inferred. The times are unchanged: 10:42 first report, 11:03 kiosk 1 back, 11:07 both lanes confirmed.
